title: AI-driven Small Business Answering Services | Virtual Reception & Call Management

facts.fact: ElevenLabs' page states its AI voice agents handle calls 24/7 for small businesses.
facts.quote: Our AI voice agents handle calls 24/7 with natural, human-like conversations.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states its AI virtual receptionist can be set up and launched as an answering service in days, not weeks, with no engineering required.
facts.quote: Upload scripts or FAQs, set hours, and launch your AI answering service in days. Not weeks. No engineering required.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs claims its expressive voice library offers more than 10,000 voices, or users can clone their own voice.
facts.quote: Choose from 10,000+ expressive voices (or clone yours) to match the accents and tones your callers trust most.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states its agents support callers in 90+ languages.
facts.quote: Support callers in 90+ languages with consistent tone and clarity.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states its lead qualification agents launch in 32 languages.
facts.quote: Launch natural, human-sounding agents in 32 languages that engage, screen, and route prospects in real time

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states the platform's agents conversations total 250,000 hours of conversations every month.
ElevenLabs states its healthcare AI agents are HIPAA-certified.
facts.quote: our HIPAA-certified AI agents automate patient and provider workflows

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states its platform connects to Twilio, HubSpot, Salesforce, and other tools via APIs and SDKs.
facts.quote: Connect ElevenAgents to your phone system, CRM, or scheduling tools via our APIs and SDKs. Twilio, HubSpot, Salesforce, and more.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states its agents can be deployed across chat, phone, email and WhatsApp channels from one design.
facts.quote: Design once, deploy everywhere including chat, phone, email and WhatsApp.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs says it has built over 400 pre-configured integrations to connect its conversational AI voice agent to other systems.
facts.quote: We've built over 400 pre-configured integrations to help you connect your conversational AI voice agent to all types of systems.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states its conversational AI delivers sub-100 ms latency.
facts.quote: ElevenLabs delivers sub-100 ms latency, 32+ languages, and enterprise-grade security.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs states its retail chatbots support 90+ languages.
facts.quote: Handle order tracking, returns, product discovery, and post-purchase support, 24/7, across every channel, in 90+ languages.

facts.fact: ElevenLabs' car dealership AI answering service demo routes callers to Sales, Service, Parts, or Finance and takes callback messages when a transfer cannot go through.
facts.quote: route them to Sales, Service, Parts, or Finance, and take complete callback messages when a transfer cannot go through.
